title: JAH LoomWeave D5-X Phase-Cell Module
description: LoomWeave D5-X is a Signature memory concept using phase-change cells alongside DRAM for instant-on persistence. The 32 GB module targets 8400 MT/s at CL36, with a supercapacitor that flushes in-flight writes on power loss. The concept bridges the gap between volatile memory and storage. Signature-original concept designed by Justin Addam Higgins. This is an original design concept, not a real product and not affiliated with any vendor.
